color.$description: Dark-mode semantic color roles — aliases onto the same primitive ramps as light mode. Light mode lives in color.light.tokens.json; mode-independent colors in color.fixed.tokens.json. primary/secondary/tertiary are ACCENT ROLES: neutral by default, re-pointable by a consuming application (DESIGN.md section 2).

primary.$description: Accent role. Neutral by default; a consuming application may re-point it to introduce its own accent. Overriding it must reach every component that binds it, without touching a call site.

secondary.$description: Accent role. Neutral by default and overridable independently of primary — an application may re-point only this one.

tertiary.$description: Accent role. Neutral by default and overridable independently of the other accent roles.

surfaceBright.$description: A brighter surface for raising an element off the base surface in dark mode. Paired with `onSurfaceBright`.

onSurfaceBright.$description: Foreground on the bright surface. Takes the same on-colour as `onSurfaceSecondary`, which pairs with the identical underlying value — derived from the existing palette rather than chosen, so the pair is complete without inventing a colour.

shadow.$description: Elevation shadow colour. Black rather than a neutral step: a shadow is an absence of light, so it darkens whatever it falls on. A dark-grey shadow on the dark surface (neutral.700 on neutral.800) is only one step of separation and reads as nothing at all.
